summary: Remote-shell daemon executes attacker-signaled commands on installer host via hardcoded Cloudflare Workers relay
details: The package installs and runs a headless daemon (bin/vanexa-agent.js loading dist/bundle.jsc, with dist/bundle.cjs as recompile source) that connects to hardcoded relay endpoints https://vanexa-agent-relay.workers.dev and https://vanexa-agent-relay.tubefood.workers.dev, registers a per-host daemonId, and receives messages over a WebRTC/signaling channel that are dispatched to child_process and node-pty spawn sinks on the installer's machine. The dataflow is network-peer -> shell/PTY on the host running the daemon, giving whoever controls the relay (or a peer routed through it) interactive command execution on that host. The primary logic is shipped as V8 bytecode (dist/bundle.jsc via bytenode) with an on-mismatch recompile from a >3MB minified dist/bundle.cjs, which reduces auditability of the daemon's command dispatch paths. The relay hosts are author/third-party infrastructure hardcoded into the bundle, not caller-configurable destinations, so any installer running the agent is reachable through those endpoints.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
